  echo: false
  freeze: false   # always rewrite the workbook, even when the site is frozen
---

```{python}
#| label: write-xlsx
import json
import sys

import pandas as pd

sys.path.insert(0, "scripts")
import analysis  # constants only; the numbers come from outputs/

prof = pd.read_csv("outputs/cluster_profiles.csv")
s = json.loads(open("outputs/summary.json").read())
sheets = {
    "profiles": prof,
    "outcomes_by_year": pd.read_csv("outputs/outcomes_by_year.csv"),
    "irca_vs_infant": pd.read_csv("outputs/irca_infant.csv"),
    "k_selection": pd.read_csv("outputs/k_selection.csv"),
    "stability": pd.read_csv("outputs/stability.csv"),
}
describe = {
    "cluster": "cluster id (1 = lowest centroid IRCA)",
    "name": "descriptive name from the profile rule in scripts/analysis.py",
    "rows": "zone-years in the cluster",
    "municipalities": "distinct municipalities with at least one zone-year in the cluster",
    "urban_row_share": "share of the cluster's rows that are urban zones",
    "irca_median": "median utility-supplied (prestadores) IRCA, 0–100",
    "irca_median_band": "Resolución 2115 de 2007 band of irca_median",
    "color": "the cluster's colour on every page",
    "outcome": "outcome column", "year": "calendar year", "median": "median value",
    "n": "rows with a value", "level": "level the outcome is measured at",
    "spearman_rho": "Spearman correlation of IRCA and infant mortality within the cluster",
    "all_clusters_rho": "the same correlation over all clusters together",
    "all_clusters_n": "rows behind all_clusters_rho",
    "k": "number of clusters", "inertia": "within-cluster sum of squares",
    "silhouette": "mean silhouette on a fixed sample of 5,000 rows",
    "ari_vs_zone": "adjusted Rand index between the clusters and the urban/rural split",
    "inertia_drop": "share of inertia removed by adding the k-th cluster",
    "seed": "random seed of the refit", "ari": "adjusted Rand index against the chosen labels",
}
for f in analysis.FEATURES:
    describe[f"mean_{f}"] = f"mean of {analysis.FEATURE_LABELS[f]}"
    describe[f"z_{f}"] = f"mean z-score (within year) of {analysis.FEATURE_LABELS[f]}"
for o, label in analysis.OUTCOMES.items():
    for stat in ("mean", "median", "n"):
        describe[f"{o}_{stat}"] = f"{stat} of {label}, pooled over the comparison years"

rows = [{"sheet": name, "column": col, "description": describe.get(col, "")}
        for name, df in sheets.items() for col in df.columns]
dictionary = pd.DataFrame(rows)
notes = pd.DataFrame({"note": [
    "Unit: municipality x zone (urban/rural) x year, 2016-2023.",
    "IRCA is the utility-supplied (prestadores) IRCA in INS open data, datos.gov.co nxt2-39c3.",
    "Comparisons are descriptive and do not establish a causal effect of water quality.",
    f"k = {s['k']}. {s['k_reason']}",
    "Sources and caveats: data/README.md in the project.",
]})

with pd.ExcelWriter("cluster_tables.xlsx") as xl:
    for name, df in sheets.items():
        df.to_excel(xl, sheet_name=name, index=False)
    dictionary.to_excel(xl, sheet_name="dictionary", index=False)
    notes.to_excel(xl, sheet_name="notes", index=False)
n_sheets = len(sheets) + 2
```

📗 [Download cluster_tables.xlsx](cluster_tables.xlsx): `{python} n_sheets` sheets, one per
table plus a column dictionary and notes. Excel is not a Quarto output format, so the code
cell on this page writes the workbook with pandas each time the page renders.
